identity.summary: Eget fysisk Deichman-bibliotek og møte-/aktivitetssted for unge 10–15 år, adskilt fra den ordinære Tøyen-filialen.

coordinate.coordNote: Offisiell adressekoordinat fra Geonorge Adresser API for Hagegata 22, OSLO. Punktet er representasjonspunktet for adressen og brukes som display-marker, ikke som kai-, vei-, vannflate- eller generelt områdeanker.

duplicateGate.conclusion: No Biblo/Hagegata 22 identity match exists in the current canonical index.

categoryDecision: litteratur is primary because the place is a dedicated public-library branch; social meeting-place and learning functions belong in content layers, not a different primary category.

documentedCore: Biblo Tøyen opened 31 March 2016 as a dedicated Deichman library for ages 10–15.
The current physical address is Hagegata 22, while ordinary Deichman Tøyen is separately located at Hagegata 28.
Books and reading remain central, alongside coding, workshops, cooking, film and other youth activities.
avoid: Do not merge Biblo with the ordinary Deichman Tøyen branch.
Do not describe the site merely as an activity club; it is a dedicated library branch.
Do not generalize Biblo as open to all ages.
